messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 43(6)

Article 43 Procedure at national level for dealing with products within the scope of this Regulation presenting a risk. 6. Member States other than the Member State initiating the procedure under this Article shall without delay inform the Commission and the other Member States of any measures adopted and of any additional information at their disposal relating to the non-compliance of the product within the scope of this Regulation concerned, and, in the event of disagreement with the adopted national measure, of their objections.

response.text:
Member States other than the initiating Member State | shallInformOfMeasures | the Commission and the other Member States of any measures adopted | without delay | shall without delay inform the Commission and the other Member States of any measures adopted
Member States other than the initiating Member State | shallInformOfAdditionalInformation | the Commission and the other Member States of any additional information at their disposal relating to the non-compliance of the product | | of any additional information at their disposal relating to the non-compliance of the product within the scope of this Regulation concerned
Member States other than the initiating Member State | shallInformOfObjections | the Commission and the other Member States of their objections | in the event of disagreement with the adopted national measure | and, in the event of disagreement with the adopted national measure, of their objections
